v1_problem: Since August 2026, CRM dispute ticket volume roughly doubled from ~600/month (Jun-Jul) to ~1180-1260/month (Aug-Sep) (E-01), and the majority of those disputed bills carry ACTUAL (meter-read) type rather than ESTIMATED type — 1785 vs 1240 (E-03). This pattern, combined with no tariff change (E-02) and dispute response times already within SLA (E-04), points to a defect in the processing of actual (non-estimated) meter reads — in AMI read delivery/validation or in billing import/calculation — that is producing incorrect bills and driving the dispute surge, rather than tariff changes, field-staffing-driven estimate substitution, or slow ticket handling.
